from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CompanyReceivables(BaseModel):
    """One company's other receivables data from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the financial report")
    other_receivables_amount: float | None = Field(description="The other receivables amount reported in yuan")
    category: Literal["高应收款", "中应收款", "低应收款", "无应收款"] | None = Field(description="The receivables category based on the task thresholds")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_receivables_list: list[CompanyReceivables]
